insight: Matthew 11:28 offers a compassionate invitation from Jesus to those burdened by heavy loads, promising rest that only He can provide. Matthew 11:29 builds on this by explaining how to receive that rest—by taking Jesus' yoke and learning from His meek and lowly heart. Together, these verses reveal that the rest Jesus offers is found not in escaping labor, but in exchanging oppressive burdens for His gentle guidance and teaching.
